**Beast Master: animal-unrest record, answers to the three questions**

My source (veldnotities.md and logboek.csv) contains no Desync, sync offset, latency, hulpslag, throughput, or polsversterker records. It also does not contain the ENG-, HIS-, ARC- or GUA- IDs, so I cannot verify them. The only timing evidence I can offer is animal observations, with onrust scored 0 to 5.

**(1) Before Day 10 02:40**
- Day 8: BEA-015 (00:20, wolves, onrust 1), BEA-016 (15:20, onrust 0).
- Day 9: BEA-017 (04:20, bever, onrust 1), BEA-018 (13:30, uil, onrust 2). No entry for the 16:45 proefopstelling.
- Day 10 before 02:40: my source is silent. No entry falls between BEA-018 and BEA-019.

**(2) Around the later windows**
- Day 10 04:45: no entry at exactly 04:45. The nearest are BEA-019 (04:40, wolves, onrust 4) and BEA-020 (04:50, herten, onrust 4). BEA-021 (11:30, onrust 2) follows.
- Day 22 04:15: BEA-046 (wolves, onrust 4), BEA-047 (04:20, herten, onrust 4), BEA-048 (09:45, onrust 2). BEA-113 is my own note of the same night.
- Day 24 11:00: silent. Entries are BEA-051 (06:55, onrust 0) and BEA-052 (12:35, onrust 0).
- Day 27 10:00: silent. Entries are BEA-058 (05:05, onrust 0) and BEA-059 (12:40, onrust 2).

**(3) Day 14, Day 16, Day 42**
- Day 14: unrest. BEA-028 (04:20, onrust 4), BEA-029 (04:25, onrust 4), BEA-030 (10:15, onrust 2).
- Day 16: low unrest only. BEA-033 (09:15, onrust 1), BEA-034 (12:50, onrust 0). I have no throughput or "38%" figure.
- Day 42: unrest. BEA-091 (04:30, onrust 5), BEA-092 (04:35, onrust 5), BEA-093 (10:45, onrust 2).
- Day 10 to Day 22: no uninterrupted calm stretch. Day 14 and Day 18 (BEA-037, 04:30, onrust 4; BEA-038, 04:35, onrust 4) both show night unrest.

**Pattern in my notes:** Night unrest at about 04:15 to 04:50 appears on Days 10, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34, 38 and 42 (BEA-113 says "Elke vierde nacht hetzelfde, sinds dag 10"). The log confirms this. It is an observed pattern in animal behaviour, not a sync interval or rule. Day 24 and Day 27 do not fall in it.

**Concessions:** Nothing in my source contradicts the Engineer or Historian. I cannot test any of their timing claims against my records.
